newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds via system RPs as fed funds tight.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds via system RPs as fed funds tight.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Thursday, the New York Fed confirmed.

The Fed's action came about an hour and a half earlier than usual due to pressure on federal funds, a source said. Funds were trading at 5-5/8 percent when the Fed entered the open market at 0958 EST/1458 GMT. Funds have since edged up to 5-11/16 percent.
Analysts noted that the month's end and settlements of bills and notes were pressuring funds this session.
